rows.label: Self-employed: estimated tax paid quarterly (15 March, June, September, December)
rows.value: Self-employed individuals file the annual return (Form S04) and the declaration of estimated income (S04a) by 15 March and pay estimated tax and contributions in four instalments: 15 March, 15 June, 15 September and 15 December.

rows.label: Self-employed: loss relief capped at 50% (not for young or small businesses)
rows.value: Business losses may be set off up to 50% of net profit each year; the cap does not apply in the first six years of the business or when gross sales are below J$15,000,000. Unused losses carry forward indefinitely.
